title: Maud Gonne’s letter
html_source: Maud Gonne, WB Yeats' lover, wrote a pamphlet urging young Irish women not to consort with the soldiers of the enemy.

anchor.prefix: lume. No, he's a grenadier. Pointed cuffs. There he is: royal Dublin fusiliers. Redcoats. Too showy. That must be why the women go after them. Uniform. Easier to enlist and drill.
anchor.suffix: about taking them off O'Connell street at night: disgrace to our Irish capital. Griffith's paper is 1961#72on the same tack now: an army rotten with venereal disease: overseas or
